basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Jake, a 22-year-old gamer and tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I recently got into Rocket League and love customizing my car with unique items. Besides gaming, I’m a big fan of movies, especially superhero flicks, and enjoy binge-watching sitcoms like Two and a Half Men. I'm currently a college student studying computer science, and in my free time, I dabble with web design using Elementor. I'm single and usually online late at night, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Jake has a solid foundation in computer science from his college coursework, which includes programming and web development. His interest in gaming has also led him to learn about game mechanics and in-game economies. His knowledge is primarily self-taught through online tutorials and community forums.
